orientation_participant_frame: Blindfolded participant seated at a table, facing the two-speaker line in front of the body; right hand rests on/holds the mouse on the sagittal movement path, left hand responds on the keyboard.
orientation_room_apparatus_frame: Two physical speakers are positioned along the sagittal plane in front of the participant, 100 cm apart. The near speaker is 10 cm from the right hand; the motor barrier is 30 cm away on the table.
orientation_body_relative_mapping: Looming is far-to-near/towards the participant's body; receding is near-to-far/away from the participant. For receding T1-T5 map to D1-D5; for looming the mapping is flipped from D5 to D1.
orientation_tactile_anchor: Electrical tactile targets are delivered either to the radial aspect of the right index finger or to the center of the chest/trunk, in separate body-part blocks.
orientation_movement_implementation: Apparent auditory motion is implemented by reciprocal near/far speaker gain envelopes. Right-hand movement is a separate motor manipulation, tracked with E-Prime at 20 Hz.
